pool: Only already legally cached LongBench RepoBench-P test Arrow and RepoBench-P_e test JSONL; no network fetch
raw_text: Exact UTF-8 context field only, no normalization, no query/answer concatenation
dedup: Deduplicate equal raw SHA256 across sources; reject duplicate ID conflicts; source preference P Arrow then P_e JSONL, source row ascending
exclusions: Union of actual historical IDs/raw SHA in old EXCLUSION_REGISTRY and old canary runtime SELECTION_EXCLUSION_REGISTRY, all 8 selected NoInflation docs, old 128 canary docs, known human Ling IDs
eligibility: Full exact context tokenized by frozen Qwen official tokenizer with add_special_tokens=False and no chat template; at least32769 tokens; no truncation before eligibility
seed_usage: Only deterministic tie-break; raw SHA ties are eliminated by dedup, no sampling RNG
project_rule: If all eligible candidates have reliable explicit repository/project IDs in snapshot schema, take first SHA-ranked candidate then first candidate with a different project; if none exists, next SHA-ranked. If reliable project identity is absent/incomplete, no inferred project labels; choose first two SHA-ranked eligible unique raw documents and report UNKNOWN.
consumed_input: input_ids[:32768], token_cursor t consumes ids[t]; scoring after ids[t] predicts ids[t+1]; retain first32769 including next target
insufficient_candidates: STOP; do not shorten length or replace pool/rule
